interrupt a speaker: It is rude to interrupt a speaker in the middle of a talk; please save your questions for the end.
在演講進行中打斷講者是很沒禮貌的；請把你的問題留到最後再問。
interrupt the power supply: Workers will interrupt the power supply to our building for three hours on Sunday to repair the old wires.
工人們將於週日中斷我們大樓的供電三小時，以修理老舊的電線。
interrupt one's studies: Because his father became ill, Tom had to interrupt his studies and go home to help run the family store.
由於父親生病，湯姆不得不中斷學業，回家幫忙經營家裡的店。
sorry to interrupt: Sorry to interrupt, but there is a phone call for you, and the caller says it's urgent.
抱歉打擾，有您的電話，來電者說事情很緊急。
invade one's privacy: Reading other people's text messages without asking is a clear way to invade their privacy.
未經詢問就讀別人的簡訊，明顯就是侵犯他人隱私。
invade the market: Cheap phones from overseas began to invade the market, forcing local companies to lower their prices.
來自海外的便宜手機開始入侵市場，迫使本地公司降價。
tourists invade the town: Every summer, thousands of tourists invade the town, filling its narrow streets and small beaches.
每年夏天，成千上萬的觀光客湧入小鎮，擠滿了狹窄的街道和小海灘。
invade a country: History shows that it is far easier to invade a country than to bring lasting peace to it afterward.
歷史證明，入侵一個國家遠比之後為它帶來持久的和平容易得多。
invent an excuse: When Jack arrived late again, he tried to invent an excuse about a traffic jam, but no one believed him.
當傑克又遲到時，他試圖編個塞車的藉口，但沒有人相信他。
invent a story: The little girl likes to invent a story about a talking rabbit every night before she goes to bed.
那個小女孩每天晚上睡前都喜歡編造一個關於會說話兔子的故事。
invent a machine: The young engineer hopes to invent a machine that can turn sea water into clean drinking water cheaply.
這位年輕的工程師希望發明一台能便宜地把海水變成乾淨飲用水的機器。
invent a word: Teenagers often invent a word on social media, and within months everyone is using it.
青少年常在社群媒體上創造新字，而不出幾個月，大家都在使用它。
invest in stocks: My uncle decided to invest in stocks after learning that saving money in the bank earns very little interest.
我叔叔在得知把錢存在銀行利息很少之後，決定投資股票。
invest time in: If you invest time in learning a second language now, it will open many doors for your future career.
如果你現在投入時間學習第二語言，它將為你未來的職涯開啟許多機會。
invest in education: Countries that invest in education usually enjoy stronger economies and healthier citizens in the long run.
投資教育的國家，長遠來看通常享有更強健的經濟和更健康的國民。
invest effort: If you invest effort in your science project every day, you will have a better chance of winning a prize at the fair.
如果你每天在自然科專題上投入心力，你就更有機會在科展中得獎。
be invested with power: After the election, the new mayor was invested with power to make changes to the city's transportation system.
選舉結束後，新任市長被授予權力，可以改革城市的交通系統。
investigate a crime: The police were called in to investigate a crime after jewelry worth millions disappeared from the museum.
在價值數百萬元的珠寶從博物館消失後，警方被請來調查這起犯罪。
investigate the cause: Experts have been sent to investigate the cause of the fire that destroyed the factory last night.
專家已被派去調查昨晚燒毀工廠那場大火的原因。
investigate a complaint: The manager promised to investigate a complaint from a customer who said a waiter had been rude to her.
經理承諾調查一位顧客的投訴，她說有位服務生對她很無禮。
involve risk: Starting your own business will always involve risk, so you should plan carefully and save some money first.
自己創業總是會涉及風險，所以你應該仔細規劃，並先存些錢。
be involved in an accident: My cousin was involved in an accident on the highway, but luckily he only had a few small cuts.
我表哥在高速公路上捲入一場事故，但幸好他只有幾處小割傷。
involve students in: Good teachers try to involve students in class discussions instead of just giving long lectures.
好老師會試著讓學生參與課堂討論，而不只是長篇大論地講課。
get involved: If you want to make new friends at school, you should get involved in clubs and volunteer activities.
如果你想在學校交新朋友，就應該參與社團和志工活動。
involve extra cost: Changing your flight to an earlier date will involve extra cost, so check the price before you decide.
把你的班機改到較早的日期會牽涉額外費用，所以決定之前先確認價格。
iron out differences: The two managers met for lunch to iron out differences over how the project budget should be spent.
兩位經理一起吃午餐，以消除他們對於專案預算該如何使用的分歧。
iron out problems: The company will test the new app for a month to iron out problems before it is released to the public.
公司將測試新的應用程式一個月，在公開發布前解決問題。
iron a shirt: Before the job interview, Kevin took ten minutes to iron a shirt so that he would look neat and professional.
工作面試之前，凱文花了十分鐘燙襯衫，好讓自己看起來整潔又專業。
strike while the iron is hot: The store is having a huge sale today, so let's strike while the iron is hot and buy the TV now.
這家店今天舉辦大特價，所以我們打鐵趁熱，現在就去買電視吧。
